prompt: When does borderless printing trim the sides of the picture?
promptZh: 何時滿版沖印會裁掉照片的兩側？

options.whyZh: 卡紙是否重用與滿版裁圖無關。

options.text: Whenever the paper is larger than the mount opening
options.whyZh: 那是裱框條件，不是是否裁圖的原因。

options.text: Whenever the source file has a white strip
options.whyZh: 規則取決於比例，未說原檔有白邊必須裁圖。

options.text: When the picture and paper have different shapes
options.zh: 照片和相紙的比例不相同時
options.whyZh: 滿版需填滿紙張，比例不同就會裁去部分畫面。

explanationZh: 滿版需填滿紙張，比例不同就會裁去部分畫面。
evidence: A borderless print fills the paper by trimming the sides of the image if its shape differs from the paper.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A borderless print fills the paper by trimming the sides of the image if its shape differs from the paper.

vocabulary.note: 沒有白邊；照片與相紙比例不同時會裁切畫面。
